claims.summary: In characteristic3 with generic ai, ti=ai^3, and um=h_m(ti+tj,ti*tj) on each pair, define C_m(z)_ij=(zi*(u_(m+1)+tj*u_m)-zj*(u_(m+1)+ti*u_m))/(ti-tj). Then q_(3m)=um, q_(3m+1)=C_m(a), q_(3m+2)=-C_m(a^2), C_m(1)=-um and C_m(t)=u_(m+1). The r=binom(N,2) prefix is retained exactly. After clearing each pair row by ti-tj, monic reduction zi^3=ti gives unique polynomial residue coefficients indexed by exponents0,1,2; original degree-two normality is equivalent to one coefficient being nonzero. No all-N nonvanishing is asserted.
claims.assessment: Working algebraic refinement of the exact ternary pair recurrence, passed by the same medium reviewer used for both architecture stages. Substitution of delta^-1=(ai-aj)/(ti-tj) proves all signs and endpoints. The finite free monic ring is the original root polynomial ring after eliminating ti. Source weights and cutoff are unchanged; the N3 two-residue control is explicit and symbolic.
claims.rationale: A faithful coordinate form chosen for a decisive nonvanishing test, explicitly equivalent to the prior recurrence and not a rank theorem or a new normality range.
claims.next_action: Prove an actual nonzero determinant residue coefficient uniformly, or identify the precise cancellation failure without growing a parameter grid.

relationships: Algebraically rewrite the exact residue-three recurrence, preserving every original prefix column and its final incomplete triple.

The known four-label rank loss remains the falsification control for dropping either endpoint term.
